title: Design System: MaC · Migration as Code

display.purpose: Figures only: metric values at 48px; nav, tab and column counts at 14px. Never a word.

headline.purpose: The one page title per screen, 36px; 30px run header; 32px under 820px.

title.purpose: Row titles, card heads, brand word, metric noun (20px), inspector h2.

body.purpose: Everything operated: nav items, buttons, node names, row titles outside the pipelines table.

meta.purpose: Row and run meta, metric captions, crumbs, node subtitles.

label.purpose: Table heads, column heads, nav section names, live-state word.

stage.purpose: Bare uppercase stage names in rows: no border, fill or padding.

mono.purpose: Ids, commit refs, repository names, logs; run id inside the run header at 0.72em.

extensions.shadowPolicy: None. --shadow and --inset are none; every base-sheet box-shadow is cancelled. The only remaining box-shadow values are 1px inset rings standing in for borders on circles, the 1px inset underline on the active tab, and the 1px gilt ring outside the primary button.

motion.name: t
motion.purpose: Background, border and colour settle on rows, nodes, nav items and buttons.

motion.name: gauge-hand
motion.purpose: The hand turns to the current stage when the runner moves.

motion.name: gauge-sweep
motion.purpose: The gilt seconds hand while a run is active; the one authored moment. Removed under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: entrances
motion.purpose: Every entrance animation from the base sheet (tab panels, cards, toasts, inspector, probes, review bar, gate, status dots) is cancelled.

narrative.overview:
The console is a fine instrument you glance at and trust. A plain silvered ground carries graphite ink, hairline rules at one device pixel, and nothing else: no filled panels, no shadows, no texture. One blued-steel accent does every job that means "live" (the running hand, the selected row, the link, the focused field), and a trace of gilt sits on the single primary action, the brand ring and the active mark on the rail. The dark theme is the same ink logic inverted onto a graphite ground (the night dial); gilt and steel lighten, nothing else changes.

Type divides by job. A Didone (Bodoni Moda) sets figures only: metric values, counts, tallies. A sturdy serif (Source Serif 4 at 500) sets every word that is a title. A humanist sans (Albert Sans) sets everything you operate, and JetBrains Mono sets identifiers. Density is generous: 32px row gutters, rows of at least 72px (a title line and up to two meta lines), one headline per screen, and a statement row of figures where a dashboard would have put tiles.

Motion is almost absent on purpose. Every entrance animation the base sheet owned is cancelled. The one authored moment is the stage gauge: its hand turns in 600ms when the runner moves, and a thin gilt seconds hand sweeps once every six seconds while a run is active. Hover and colour changes settle in 180ms.
keyCharacteristics: Hairlines instead of surfaces; panels are transparent on the ground.
One gilt primary action per screen; everything else is ink on hairline.
Bodoni Moda for figures only; Source Serif 4 for titles; Albert Sans for UI; JetBrains Mono for ids.
Stable state colours: blued steel = active/selected/link, ink = succeeded, red = failed, faint = cancelled/undone/skipped, amber = breakpoint/awaiting review.
One authored motion (the gauge hand and sweep); the rest settles in 180ms or does not move.
Generous rhythm: 72px rows, 32px gutters, a 288px rail, one headline per screen.

rules.name: The One Gilt Rule
rules.body: Gilt appears on the single primary action, the brand and agent rings, the active rail mark, the sweep and the selection highlight. It is never a surface and never a fill, except the `new` count.

rules.name: The Stable Meaning Rule
rules.body: Blued steel means active, selected or a link; ink means succeeded; red means failed; faint means cancelled, undone or skipped; amber means a breakpoint or a pending review. A colour never changes meaning between the gauge, the pill, the node and the edge.

rules.name: The Night Inversion Rule
rules.body: The dark theme inverts the ink logic onto `night-ground`; steel lifts to `night-blued-steel`, gilt to `night-gilt`, red to `night-bad`. Hairline alphas move to white. No other rule changes between themes.

rules.name: The Figures-Only Didone Rule
rules.body: Bodoni Moda sets numbers and never a word. If a string contains letters it is set in Source Serif 4 or Albert Sans.

rules.name: The One Headline Rule
rules.body: One 36px headline per screen. Everything else on the page is title size (18–20px) or smaller.

rules.name: The Small-Caps Stage Rule
rules.body: Stage names are bare uppercase sans at 10.5px with 0.1em tracking, muted, with no border, fill or padding. They read as engraving, not as chips.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: A rule is one device pixel: 1px, 0.5px at 2dppx. Nothing is thicker; the only 2px stroke in the system is a failed gauge mark.

rules.name: The Transparent Panel Rule
rules.body: Cards, frames, tables, the inspector, the metrics row, the chat main and the knowledge page have no background. They are hairline outlines on the ground.

dos: Do draw every rule as a hairline: 1px, 0.5px at 2dppx, in `hairline` or `hairline-strong`.
Do keep panels transparent on the ground; outline them, never fill them.
Do set figures in Bodoni Moda and words in Source Serif 4 (titles) or Albert Sans (UI).
Do give each screen one primary action: an ink fill with a 1px gilt ring and a gilt icon.
Do keep table rows at 72px or taller, padded 12px 32px, with a title line and up to two meta lines.
Do present page figures as one ruled statement, figure and noun on one baseline, stacked with rules between under 820px.
Do use the stage gauge wherever a run's progress is shown: large in the run header, small in every row.
Do keep state colours stable across gauge, pill, node and edge.
donts: Don't add shadows, glows or entrance animations; nothing moves but the gauge hand and sweep.
Don't fill pills or chips; status is an outline and stages are bare small caps.
Don't set a word in Bodoni Moda or a headline larger than 36px.
Don't thicken a border past a hairline; the only 2px stroke is a failed gauge mark.
Don't reintroduce the sunburst or any ground texture; both themes are plain.
Don't use gilt as a surface or on anything but the primary action, the brand and agent rings, the active rail mark and the sweep.
Don't introduce a green; the "ok" tone is blued steel.
